notes.title: Week 1 — Circuit Concepts
notes.description: 108 slides with step-by-step solutions. Charge, current, voltage, power and the sign convention, KCL, KVL, Ohm's law, dividers, equivalent resistance (with every exam trap), Wheatstone bridge, dependent sources.

notes.title: Week 2 — Nodal and Mesh Analysis
notes.description: 74 slides with step-by-step solutions. Node voltage and mesh current methods, matrices by inspection, supernodes, supermeshes, dependent sources, and how to pick the faster method.

notes.title: Week 3 — Thévenin, Norton and Maximum Power
notes.description: 68 slides with step-by-step solutions. Superposition, source transformations, Thévenin and Norton equivalents, the test-source method, maximum power transfer, load lines and meter loading.

notes.title: Week 4 — Capacitors, Inductors and Transients
notes.description: 73 slides with step-by-step solutions. C and L laws and energy, DC steady state, first-order RC/RL transients, second-order RLC (over, critical, underdamped), overshoot and settling.

notes.title: Week 5 — Sinusoidal Sources
notes.description: 57 slides with step-by-step solutions. Sinusoids, phase, lead and lag, average and RMS values (derived), complex numbers and why they represent sinusoids.

notes.title: Week 6 — Phasors and AC Circuit Analysis
notes.description: 60 slides with step-by-step solutions. Phasors, impedance and admittance, phasor diagrams, AC dividers, AC nodal and mesh, AC Thévenin, sources at different frequencies.

notes.title: Week 7 — AC Power and Power Factor
notes.description: 62 slides with step-by-step solutions. Instantaneous, average, reactive and complex power, the power triangle, power factor correction, AC maximum power (fully derived).

notes.title: Week 8 — Transformers and Impedance Matching
notes.description: 51 slides with step-by-step solutions. Ideal transformer, turns ratio, dot convention, reflected impedance, impedance matching for maximum power, real transformers and efficiency.

notes.title: Week 9 — Three-Phase Power
notes.description: 57 slides with step-by-step solutions. Balanced Y and delta, line vs phase quantities, the per-phase method, three-phase power and correction, residential wiring, power distribution.

notes.title: Week 10 — Magnetic Circuits and Materials
notes.description: 58 slides with step-by-step solutions. Ampère and Faraday, reluctance and air gaps, inductance, mutual inductance, B–H curves, boundary conditions, magnetic energy.

notes.title: Week 11 — Electromechanical Energy Conversion
notes.description: 52 slides with step-by-step solutions. Force on a current, motional EMF, the linear machine as motor and generator, torque on a coil, magnetic pull, efficiency.

notes.title: Week 12 — Electric Machines
notes.description: 54 slides with step-by-step solutions. DC motors and generators (shunt, series, separately excited), synchronous machines, induction motors and slip, power flow and regulation.

notes.title: Final Review — Every Trap and Mixed Exam Practice
notes.description: 45 slides with step-by-step solutions. A trap sheet for every week, which method to use when, everything to memorize, and 12 mixed exam-style problems with full solutions.

notes.title: Bonus — Operational Amplifiers
notes.description: 36 slides with step-by-step solutions. Ideal op-amp rules (and why they hold), inverting, non-inverting, buffer, summing, difference, integrator, differentiator, active filter.
